data.name: OVERDRIVE
data.detailed_description:
Classic Chaotic Arcade Racing

OVERDRIVE lives and breathes the chaos and destruction from the golden era of arcade racers. There's no rules or redflags here, cut every corner, ram every opponent, boost headlong through a pack of 32 opponents at the edge of control and detonate across the finish-line!

Asymmetrical Racing

Quad Bikes, Buggies & Racing Trucks, each vehicle has it's own racing style, victory will be determined by how you adapt to the strengths and weaknesses of your vehicle. Are you nimble enough to avoid danger or will you be crushed beneath the wheels of heavier vehicles?

Immersive Track Design

OVERDRIVE tracks branch, weave and crumble as you race, a valid path last lap may be strewn with debris or set aflame. Bridges crumble under the weight of heavy vehicles, fire spreads from heavy crashes, mud grows slick the more it's tread. No two laps are the same, adapt, experiment and carve your own path... or close off all your opponents options.

data.short_description: Explosive offroad racing with 32 vehicles on dynamic branching tracks. From Quad Bikes to Racing Trucks, weaving through shortcuts or plowing through trees, each vehicle has their own racing style.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS *: Windows 7 64-Bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500, AMD FX-8100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit or later
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i7-10700F or equivalent
